column1: # 历史 checksum 白名单（legacy migration checksums）
# 背景：部分迁移文件在发布后被修改过，导致早期安装的客户库中
# schema_migrations 记录的 checksum 与当前包内文件不一致，升级时
# 会被 checksum 校验硬阻断。
# 本文件登记这些文件的全部历史 checksum（从 git 历史穷举生成）。
# runner 命中白名单时：校正记账为当前值 + 打印 legacy 日志 + 跳过执行。
# 安全前提：这些迁移的当前版本均为幂等设计（CREATE TABLE/INDEX/ADD COLUMN
# IF NOT EXISTS；数据修正语句带 WHERE 守卫），已逐个核对。
# 格式：<迁移文件名><TAB><历史 sha256>
# JJDGuard 1.7.0 published a broader passport seed regex. Migration 132
# subsequently tightens the rule, so an applied 1.7.0 checksum is a valid
# immutable predecessor and must not rerun migration 068.
# Permanent legacy fork: production applied the pre-b6addfd3 form while
# environment_scope existed through another path; b6addfd3 removed that
# dependency because migrations 146/147/148 create the column later. The
# release form is the correct ordered-install fix; keep this historical
# checksum permanently because it is a reasonable production fork, not drift.
# Permanent legacy fork: the production checksum predates the committed
# release form. Exhaustive audit searched reachable/unreachable Git objects,
# all Gitee branches, both local bare repos, every registered worktree, the
# 2.6.3 artifact, candidate directories, and production upgrade backups; the
# matching bytes were never recovered and are not present in Git. Keep this
# checksum permanently as an explicit unrecoverable historical fork.
# Published synchronous forms replaced by expand-only migrations. These exact
# checksums remain accepted and are never re-executed; migration 834 owns the
# Published synchronous form replaced by the bounded security_event_delivery_v1
# task in migration 840. The exact checksum remains accepted and is not rerun.
# Published synchronous forms replaced by bounded tasks in migrations 842-843.
# Published rollup aggregation replaced by usage_rollup_dimensions_v1.
# Published 855 first form was replaced before customer package acceptance; retain its checksum for upgrade audit.
